title: api kingman
summary: An API gateway has one FIFO worker. Mean arrival rate is 0.8 requests per minute and mean service time is 1 minute. The squared coefficient of variation of interarrival times is 4.0 and of service times is 0.25. The team must estimate steady-state mean queueing delay using an approximation that accounts for this non-Markov variability; an M/M/1 estimate from means alone is not accepted.
